rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for people coming back together after separation.

example.traditional: 我哋終於可以聚返埋一齊喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 zeoi6 faan1 maai4 jat1 cai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when romantic partners get back together after breaking up.

example.english: They decided to reunify after breaking up.
example.traditional: 佢哋分手之後決定復合。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6 kyut3 ding6 fuk6 hap6

rows.note: Use this especially when separated family members or loved ones come together again.

example.english: Mum was abroad for years and finally came home so we could reunify.
example.traditional: 阿媽去咗外國幾年，終於返嚟同我哋團聚。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 gei2 nin4 zung1 jyu1 faan1 lei4 tung4 ngo5 dei6 tyun4 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this for restoring the unity of countries, territories, or political entities.

example.english: The government says it will reunify the two territories step by step.
example.traditional: 政府話會逐步將兩地統一返。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 zuk6 bou6 zoeng1 loeng5 dei6 tung2 jat1 faan1
